emails.subject: CarrierConnect is ready for your assistance messages
emails.body:
Hello Ines,

Your TripSteady Companion connection to Nina Leung's Passenger Assistance team at Northwind Airways is active. Companion can prepare and send a short disruption summary to us with your booking reference, passenger details, and preferred call-back number when a trip issue seems to need carrier input. The rebooking desk reviews incoming messages throughout the day and prioritizes same-day connections.

If you are in danger or feel unsafe, contact airport staff or local emergency services instead of using CarrierConnect.

- Northwind Airways Passenger Assistance

emails.subject: After Reykjavik - glad we got you rebooked quickly
emails.body:
Dear Ines,

I am glad Companion reached us quickly after your overnight stranding in Reykjavik and that the rebooking desk was able to get you onto a new flight and into a hotel the same night. Please keep using Companion for everyday trip support, for helping you decide what to ask us, and for looping us in when a situation seems to need carrier review.

Warmly,
Nina Leung
Passenger Assistance lead, Northwind Airways
